parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` and `TrackContainerProtocol` in the `Playback` package share three identical fields — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, and `pageToken:String?` — and differ only in the concrete type of the `item` field (`Show` vs `Track`). The structural evidence confirms `shared_field_count: 4` with a single differing slot (`item:Show` vs `item:Track`), which is the canonical PAT signal: a family of protocols that are identical except for one type parameter. Introducing a PAT `ContainerProtocol` with `associatedtype Item` and moving the three shared fields into it eliminates the duplication while preserving the distinct `item` types through the associated type. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no restraint override applies.
